(defn- sanitize-classes "sanitize class-combos where a class-combo is: [marker-class optional-class...] where marker-class and optional-class can be a string or regular expression. (defn- doc->docs "Returns `doc` broken down into headings with any text belong to those headings. Url paths are resolved from `version-entity`.
